name: Shisho-san to Issho☆
source:
Main character is an ordinary student during last year of school study. He is in charge of library committee that no one cares about. But one day a goddess comes to the library!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通学生，正处于在校最后一年。他负责无人关心的图书委员会。可是有一天，一位女神来到图书馆！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
